sources.t: One million people have mapped their mobile
sources.f: Published 29 May 2026; Ofcom reported one million uses of its postcode-based Map Your Mobile coverage and performance checker.
sources.g: Crowdsourced and predicted mobile results do not prove fixed-broadband service at an exact parcel.

sources.f: Official postcode tool displays predicted 4G/5G coverage and district-level performance by network.
